description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act. No 11 of 2021 " REMEDIUMONE GLOBAL (PVT) LTD "
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory powers under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It specifies legal exemptions and incentives for a business entity under various tax and finance acts, making it a regulatory matter that falls under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
